name: self-improving-harness
description: Search the joint design space of context management, workflow control, tool and subagent orchestration, memory, permissions, and evaluation for a self-improving LLM harness. Mine verifier-grounded failures, propose narrow and diverse code-level harness edits, and accept an edit only when it resolves the measured weakness without regression on held-in and held-out evaluation.

prefer.acceptance_rule: preserve passing behavior and require non-regression on held-in and held-out evaluation
